name: Jana Novotná
bio:
Jana's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years as a meticulous automotive refinisher, a chance encounter with a local rally team led to an invitation to join their crew. Her precision and eye for detail quickly made her indispensable. She thrives under pressure, ensuring every car leaves the paint shop flawless, reflecting not only the team's brand but also her own commitment to excellence. Jana has a talent for spotting and correcting even the most minor imperfections, a skill highly valued in the demanding world of Formula 1. She joined Haas F1 Team ten years ago, originally as an assistant, and through hard work and dedication, has become the lead paint shop specialist.

Jana brings a pragmatic approach to every task, prioritizing efficiency and quality. She is known for her ability to troubleshoot paint-related issues quickly and effectively, minimizing downtime and maximizing performance. Her leadership extends beyond technical skills; she's a valued mentor, patiently guiding younger team members and sharing her vast knowledge of paint technology and application techniques. Jana's calm demeanor and unwavering focus make her a pillar of the Haas F1 team.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly tied back in a low bun, with a few strands escaping around her face.
physical.description: Jana is a woman of medium height with a sturdy build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always wears a pair of well-worn leather work gloves, even when not directly working on a car.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing a pot of strong coffee first thing every morning, sharing it with the entire paint shop team.
